title: Special Executive Programme In Renewable Energy And Sustainability Management
description: Gain expertise in renewable energy and sustainability management, focusing on energy sources, policies, and business models.
longDescription: This programme covers the fundamentals of renewable energy sources and explores their role in the global energy transition. Participants will also learn about sustainability management, risk mitigation, and the business models shaping the renewable energy industry.
courseDetails: Fossil Fuel and Climate Change. Environment and Health Impacts of Fossil Fuel. The Environmental Impact of Renewable Energy. Renewable Energy Challenges and Opportunities. Energy Transition. Major Players in the Energy Sector. Renewable energy technologies. Renewable energy market forecast. Renewable energy business model. Major financing structures. The optimum financing structure. Challenges to renewable energy business model. Renewable energy storage. Energy transition focus area. Supply chain strategies for renewables. Renewable energy supply chain development. Supply Chain Ecosystem. Renewable energy risk management. Barriers to implementing renewable energy technologies (RET). Policymaking on Renewable Energy. Market Design and Regulations. Off-grid Policies. Polices on Decarbonization. International Initiatives for Climate Change. Energy Burden. Sustainable Energy. The circular economy. The course begins with an introduction to renewable energy sources, such as solar, wind, hydroelectric, and biomass, while addressing global energy consumption trends. It explores the environmental impacts of both fossil fuels and renewable energy and discusses the challenges and opportunities within the energy transition. Participants will also learn about renewable energy business models, financing structures, and supply chain development, emphasizing risk management. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to Renewable Energy: The Nature and Challenges of Renewable Energy: Renewable Energy Business Development Model: Renewable Energy Supply Chain and Risk Management: Renewable Energy Policies and Sustainable Development:
